notes.title: Ukranian Games Festival: Save 31%
notes.content:
[p][i]BROKEN LIFE[/i] is taking part in the [b]Ukrainian Games Festival - [/b]a large-scale initiative celebrating the future of the Ukrainian gaming industry. The festival, organized by [url="https://Palaye.net"]Palaye.net[/url], starts on August 14.[/p][p]This game is about war, loneliness, and the struggle with depression caused by loss. It’s a story of pain and perseverance, where every step forward is a quiet act of courage.[/p][p]During the festival, [i]BROKEN LIFE[/i] is available with a [b]31% discount[/b]. Now is the time to experience this heartfelt journey.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545229/4f76f02ef09f324b9b6ea5d484d7d5f7cb6682f5.png"][/img][/p][p]The festival also features many other remarkable projects from talented Ukrainian developers. I encourage you to explore their work and support the growth of the Ukrainian game industry.[/p][p]Sincerely,
— [i]IkkoSama[/i][/p]

notes.title: Skip the slide puzzle patch
notes.content:
Some players asked for the possibility to skip the Slide puzzle "Heart". Added this feature.

Also fixed bug caused by the feature "Stretch screen". Now the game displays correctly at any resolution

notes.title: Early Access Update Patch
notes.content: [p]Hi there! Long time no see. [/p][p]I'm safe and still working on the game release. [/p][p]Chapter 2 will be mind-blowing, but now I wish to publish some improvements to the game.[/p][h3]Features implemented:[/h3][list][*][p]Steam Cloud Saves. Never lose your progress, even if you delete and reinstall the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic Saves. Pause the game on PC and continue from the same spot on Steam Deck or vice versa.[/p][/*][*][p]Stretch screen to monitor is now an option. The game doesn't stretch on non-16:9 monitors by default now. Game experience on Ultra-wide monitors is absolutely improved.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Requested features implemented:[/h3][list][*][p]Separate options for voice-over and subtitles languages. Now you can choose what language you want to read and what language you want to hear.[/p][/*][*][p]Save before bedtime story. If you want to play the story again, just load the autosave before interacting with other objects in the Childroom.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Localization[/h3][list][*][p]Finnish (Suomi) localization added—special thanks to Ilmari "Ippe" Aropaltio for the help.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese localization improved—special thanks to Colt for the help.[/p][/*][*][p]Some minor fixes in other languages.[/p][/*][/list][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545229/b2ea02e37eacb08e68f158ff7a76d435cbb3cf7e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545229/3bf15c4c21554b3e8517d8d2d71a4bb58bd67ac8.png"][/img][/url][/p][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]A lot of bugs were fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: BROKEN LIFE is available in Early Access
notes.content:
That day has come. It has been a long journey, full of obstacles. However, I made it through.

Meet Broken Life, a 2d Point-and-Click adventure set in the midst of war.

The game is currently in early access. The first of three chapters of this fascinating and tragic story is available for players to review.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545229/9d010ae18dd9b9890c08da77162a1206e7681f43.png[/img]

[b][h2]Support the developer and buy the game with a 20% discount to celebrate the launch.[/h2][/b]
Share your impressions in the comments section. Best regards, IkkoSama.

notes.title: Human Voiceover added!
notes.content:
A lot of people argued that AI voiceover sounds robotic and doesn't have a soul. So, now you can enjoy my own voice in a game. Added my native language - Ukranian and my poor-accented English. 

Disclaimer: English version is not so good as it should be. I'll try to fix this on release. 

Anyway, i hope you'll like new voiceover. Don't forget to wishlist the game. 
Sincerely yours, Ikkosama.

notes.title: BROKEN LIFE at Ukrainian Games Festival 2024!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that Demo of my game BROKEN LIFE is participating in the Ukrainian Games Festival 2024 on Steam! This festival brings together the best Ukrainian games and developers, and I can't wait to share with you a story about loss, hope, and the fight for freedom.

Ukrainian Games Festival 2024 -https://store.steampowered.com/sale/UkrainianGames2024
👾 Festival dates: 19 - 26 August 2024

Join the festival, support the Ukrainian gaming industry and discover the exciting and tragic adventure of BROKEN LIFE! 🕹️

notes.title: Demo translated on 15 languages!

Added:
- Portuguese 
- Italian
- Spanish
- French
- Czech
- Polish
- Romanian
- Turkish

Added in previous updates:
- English
- Ukrainian
- German
- Chinese simplified
- Chinese traditional
- Korean
- Japanese

Unrelated updates:

- minor bug fixes

Please send me email on brokenlifegame@gmail.com if you spot any spelling mistakes in my translations.

notes.title: BROKEN LIFE LIVE STREAM! June 14, 2024
notes.content:
LIVE STREAM! June 14, 2024

Hello, everyone! My name is Kostiantyn and I am a solo game developer from Ukraine. I work hard to create a rich and immersive story based on my own experiences of living through war. Be prepared for the journey through dark and atmospheric 2D environments, solving puzzles that are integrated into the emotional story.
